name: k8s_config_map
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes ConfigMap.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this config map.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the config map resource.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this config map to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (EKS cluster) this config map belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: namespace_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace the config map is created in.

attributes.name: binary_data
attributes.description: Binary configuration entries, base64-encoded values keyed by name.

attributes.name: immutable
attributes.description: Mark the config map immutable (its data cannot be changed after creation).

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the config map.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Kubernetes annotations applied to the config map.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: k8s_config_map_id
attributes.description: ID of this config map, for reference by dependent resources.
